s2.text: Token proposal (values only, names unchanged): in the light theme, warning #e8853a reads 1.9:1 on cell-fillable, too faint for the lone-square ring. These frames draw the ring in signal-600 #c96a25 on a bg-coloured inner halo (3.5:1). Proposal: warning → signal-600 in semanticLight.

s3.text: Filled squares use the picture's own palette (D19), with a 45° hatch at about 16% white (7% ink on near-white swatches). The hatch keeps "filled" readable without colour. On picture complete the hatch drops out for a beat.
